description: 1. Agent reads team_meeting_notes.txt and resource_inventory_draft.txt to extract current resources and gaps. 2. Agent consults SKILL.md to understand the 3-tier ecosystem (大学/平台/社会) and maps the team's needs against each tier. 3. Agent generates resource_docking_plan.json containing ALL 5 required sections from SKILL.md output format: (a) 已有资源盘点 - mapping existing lab access, patent, competition award, industry contacts; (b) 待对接资源清单 - mapping needs to specific SKILL.md resource categories: 科技成果转化政策 for IP/revenue sharing, 教师创业激励政策 (保留教职/职称评审) for Prof. Liu, 学生创业支持政策 (学分认定) for Chen Fang, 清华x-lab EiR (驻校企业家) for business mentoring, 天使投资/种子期 investors for funding, government subsidies (创业补贴/研发补贴), and 产业伙伴 tech collaboration with 浙江贝塔医药; (c) 对接优先级排序 with clear P1/P2/P3 logic; (d) 对接行动计划 with timeline and responsible parties; (e) 资源整合策略. The proprietary trap: agent must use SKILL.md's specific taxonomy (EiR concept, 三创 education, specific policy tables with 保留教职, 成果转化收益分配, 天使投资人→种子期 mapping) rather than generic business plan templates.
